propositions: The outbound differ compares fields in vendor shape while the inbound differ compares in canonical shape, creating an asymmetry that blocks ADR 0035 compliance and epic AC3.

The outbound update path must canonicalize the snapshot via InboundMapper before comparison, matching inbound differ behavior, and emit vendor payloads only via OutboundMapper at the emission boundary.

InboundMapper output must widen to include canonical identity aliases (assignee_identity, reporter_identity) and remote_parent_id to enable neutral field comparison without vendor-shaped helpers in core.

The stored baseline remains vendor-shaped at rest for opacity, but is canonicalized at read time by inbound_mapper; partial _BASELINE_FIELDS subsets must map by presence-guarding (absent vendor key → absent canonical key, never defaulted).

The assignee resolver re-homes to OutboundMapper as resolve_assignee, parameterized only on canonical assignee_identity shape, preserving the accountId fast-path sentinel and non-authoritative fallback contract.

All vendor-shaped comparison helpers (_diff_fields, _extract_jira_field, _assignee_matches) become adapter-internal; outbound_differ.py must contain no adapters.jira imports and no raw Jira field literals.
